facts.claim: Anatomy indexed from 'Digital Anatomy of Four Music-Marketing Machines' research report (2026-10-03); per-fact evidence tiers and sources recorded in attrs.key_facts
Per impression: Total Value = (Advertiser Bid x Estimated Action Rate) + User Value/Ad Quality; highest total value wins - not highest bid
Estimated Action Rate = est. CTR x est. click-to-conversion probability, predicted from the user's full behavior history, time-of-day/device patterns, session context, and cross-platform activity
Bid strategies: Lowest Cost, Cost Cap, Bid Cap, ROAS Target; pricing is second-price-like (VCG), so winners pay below their bid
The delivery algorithm reads ad engagement (views, clicks, comments - negative comments count as engagement) to narrow delivery; creative 'self-selects' audience as interest targeting narrows
Press/editorial coverage gives retargeting creative fresh angles and social proof, lowering CPC through higher engagement rates (which feed the auction's quality component)
